name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
August 10, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
RECOGNITION OF INTERNATIONAL HOUSE OF PANCAKES - It is recommended the City Council present Tom Lustbaum and Arturo Martinez with a Certificate of Appreciation and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
5.1 Recognition of IHOP
5.2
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE – It is recommended the City Council recognize BT McNicholl for his years of service and present him with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
5.2 Recognition of City Employee
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENT TO THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council appoint Cathy Alvarez to the La Mirada Community Foundation for a term ending in May 2023.
7.1 Appointment to the Foundation
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of July 13, 2021 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of July 13, 2021.
8.1 Minutes of 7-13-21 SS Mtg.
8.1 Minutes of 7-13-21 CC Mtg.
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated August 10, 2021 in the total amount of $6,357,088.32.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING MAY 2021 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending May 2021.
8.3 Monthly Treasurer Report - May 2021
8.4
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING JUNE 2021 (FIRST CLOSE) - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending June 2021.
8.4 Monthly Treasurer Report - June 2021
8.5
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING JUNE 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending June 2021.
8.5 Investment Report - June 2021
8.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-07, SLURRY SEAL OF SANTA GERTRUDES AVENUE FROM LEMON DRIVE TO LA MIRADA BOULEVARD AND HILLSBOROUGH DRIVE FROM ALICANTE ROAD TO BEACH BOULEVARD – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-07, Slurry Seal of Santa Gertrudes Avenue from Lemon Drive to La Mirada Boulevard and Hillsborough Drive from Alicante Road to Beach Boulevard, to Doug Martin Contracting Company, Inc. in the amount of $414,608; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project construction cost.
8.6 CIP No. 2021-07
8.7
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-04, GYMNASIUM HVAC INSTALLATION – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by HJ Mechanical; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
8.7 CIP No. 2018-04
8.8
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2020-05, SPLASH! PUMP ROOM CONTROLS UPGRADE PROJECT PHASE I – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by California Commercial Pools, Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
8.8 CIP No. 2020-05
8.9
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH AMERINAT - It is recommended the City Council approve an agreement with AmeriNat for escrow and loan services and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
8.9 Agreement with AmeriNat
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
ORDINANCE NO. 718 SETTING CALIFORNIA PRIMARY ELECTION DATES AS THE CITY COUNCIL ELECTION DATES AS REQUIRED BY LAW - It is recommended the City Council introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 718 setting California Primary Election dates as the City Council Election dates as required by law, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.1 Ordinance No. 718 - First Reading
9.2
ORDINANCE NO. 719 ADDING CHAPTER 2.35 TO THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE REGARDING ELECTRONIC FILING OF CAMPAIGN DISCLOSURE STATEMENTS AND STATEMENTS OF ECONOMIC INTEREST - It is recommended the City Council introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 719 adding Chapter 2.35 to the La Mirada Municipal Code regarding electronic filing of campaign disclosure statements and Statements of Economic Interest, by title only, and waive further reading; approve an agreement with Netfile to implement an electronic filing system for campaign disclosure documents and Statements of Economic Interest in the amount of $4,100 annually; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
9.2 Ordinance No. 719 - First Reading
